title: lucuma balansana
intro: Lucuma balansana, commonly known as the yellow or golden lucuma, is a species of tree native to the Andes in South America. This plant is a rich source of nutrients and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the ability to aid in digestion, lower blood sugar levels, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Lucuma balansana include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress, improve immune function, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of Lucuma balansana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
